abstract: Primary carcinoma of the fallopian tube is a rare malignancy of the female genital tract and infrequently diagnosed before an operation. The majority of patients have extensive disease at the time of diagnosis. We have experienced incidentally a case of a carcinoma of the fallopian tube coexisting with a benign cystic teratoma of the ovary in a 25-year-old woman. We report this case with a brief review of literatures.
abstract_ja: 25歳女性に生じた卵管原発癌を偶発的に発見した。本例は卵巣の良性嚢胞性奇形腫を併存していた。卵管原発癌は女性生殖器のまれな悪性腫瘍であり、術前に診断されることは少なく、大多数の症例で診断時に広範な病変を有する。文献の簡単な概説を付す。
